note: 知识卡片板块 · 图片风格提示词。不设品牌素材层：每期按口播现生成。1.7 起图片分三类（brand.json → imagery.categories）：类别 1 实物贴纸（口播直接说到的东西：real 写实为核心，anime 做高光版，device 手持手机）；类别 2 意象插画（口播没直说、要让观众意会的意思：sc02 铅笔漫画模切贴纸）；类别 3 氛围装饰（不讲内容，只加质感：ambient 写实虚化道具 + 程序化光斑）。素材尽量透明底。停用的风格 / 做法（status = 停用）genimg.py 默认拒绝。preset：普通风格用 id（如 real），带做法的用 id-做法（如 sc02-line）。

real.name: 写实产品摄影
real.use: 名词实物化：芯片、服务器、锁、钥匙、手机、硬盘……知识卡片里最常用的图片；也用于需要「真东西」的镜头
real.prompt_suffix: photorealistic studio product photography, real physical materials such as brushed metal, anodized aluminium, glass and matte plastic, low-key lighting, one soft warm key light from the upper left and a clear warm rim light outlining the whole silhouette, subtle realistic reflections, slightly desaturated natural colors, macro lens, sharp focus, isolated on a plain medium grey (#8A8A8A) seamless background, centered, full object visible, no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no logo, no watermark
real.post: python3 -I tools/cutout.py object 原图 抠图.png（实心物件加 --fill-holes）→ python3 -I tools/grade.py 抠图.png 输出.png
real.placement: 炭黑场为主，可以出血；一屏一个主体。暗色物件（黑色机箱、深色锁体）必须有完整的暖色轮廓光，否则轮廓会被炭黑底吃掉
subjects: a square AI processor chip, black ceramic package with brushed aluminium heat spreader, gold pins on all four sides, a faint warm orange glow leaking from the die edge
a closed heavy padlock, brushed stainless steel shackle, matte dark graphite body
a single 1U rack-mounted server, three-quarter view, black anodized aluminium front panel with fine ventilation mesh, a few tiny warm orange status LEDs
real.rules: 物件保留本来的颜色（金属就是金属色），不再限制三色；高饱和的点只允许朱橙（状态灯、发光写成 warm orange），不要绿灯、蓝光、紫光。AI 生成硬件容易出假细节：提示词里不要求屏幕、标签、文字，挑图时检查乱码和错误结构。暗色物件在提示词里写明 warm rim light。
real.samples: cards/images/samples/bmz_*.png（P5 样张 12 张，提示词 samples/prompts.json）；预览 docs/previews/sheet_stickers.jpg

anime.name: 动漫光效
anime.role: 类别 1 · 高光版（全期 1–2 个关键时刻）
anime.use: 类别 1 的高光版：开场主体、金句、关键一步这类全期最重要的一两个时刻；只画物件
anime.prompt_suffix: detailed anime film background art style, painterly hand-drawn object, rich lighting with glowing light bloom and lens glow, deep night-blue shadows and warm vermilion orange light, fine clean line work, highly detailed, cinematic, isolated object on a plain light grey (#D6D6D6) seamless background, three-quarter view, full object visible, no characters, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark
anime.post: python3 -I tools/cutout.py object 原图 抠图.png → python3 -I tools/grade.py 抠图.png 输出.png
anime.placement: 炭黑场；一屏最多一个动漫图，作为该屏的焦点（它自带朱橙光，等于这一屏的朱橙焦点）；不和写实图放在同一个镜头
subjects: a square AI processor chip with a glowing core, pins on all four sides
a closed padlock
a single rack-mounted server unit with ventilation grille and small status lights
anime.rules: 一期里用得少才显得贵：只给高光时刻。同一期多次出现时用同一段描述保持一致。人物和情境仍用 SC02；anime 只画物件和空场景，不画人物。
anime.samples: cards/images/samples/anime/（P5 样张：物件 4 张 + 场景 2 张）；预览 docs/previews/sheet_stickers.jpg

scene.name: 动漫场景
scene.use: 空场景：金库门、机房走廊、深夜工位……放进卡片 / 窗口里，或做章节卡、金句卡的画面
scene.prompt_suffix: detailed anime film background art, painterly hand-drawn environment, cinematic composition, rich lighting with glowing light bloom, deep night-blue shadows and warm vermilion orange light sources, highly detailed, no characters, no people, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark
scene.post: python3 -I tools/grade.py 原图 输出（不抠图）；位图只放在卡片 / 窗口里，不整屏铺底
scene.retired_reason: 整张带背景，和「素材尽量透明」冲突（2026-11-27 用户确认停用）

ambient.name: 氛围道具（写实虚化）
ambient.use: 不讲内容，只加画面丰富度和质感：键帽、网线、螺丝、电路板碎片、数据线、硬盘这类和账号相关的小物件，放在画面边缘做前景 / 远景
ambient.prompt_suffix: photorealistic studio product photography, real physical materials such as brushed metal, anodized aluminium, matte plastic and braided cable, low-key lighting, soft warm key light from the upper left and a subtle rim light, neutral desaturated colors only, no orange, no colored lights, no glowing parts, macro lens, sharp focus, isolated on a plain medium grey (#8A8A8A) seamless background, centered, full object visible, no text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no logo, no watermark
ambient.post: python3 -I tools/cutout.py object 原图 抠图.png → python3 -I tools/grade.py 抠图.png 输出.png --sat 0.3（素材保持清晰；虚化、压暗在渲染时加）
ambient.placement: 网页 .amb.near（前景：大、blur 14px、亮度 0.6，可出血）/ .amb.far（远景：小、blur 4px、亮度 0.48）；AE 高斯模糊 + 曝光。每屏 ≤ 3 个，不进章节进度条区，不挡主体和字
subjects: three loose mechanical keyboard keycaps in matte charcoal grey
a loosely coiled grey ethernet network cable with a transparent RJ45 connector
four small brushed steel screws scattered loosely
a small broken fragment of a dark graphite circuit board
a black braided USB-C cable loosely curled
a small M.2 SSD memory stick
ambient.rules: 不带朱橙（一屏一个朱橙焦点）；永远不抢焦点；主体是 SC02 模切贴纸的镜头不用写实道具，只用程序化光斑 .bokeh。

sticker.name: 陶瓷贴纸
sticker.use: 名词实物化：芯片、钥匙、锁、盾牌、公文包……知识卡片里最常用的图片
sticker.prompt_suffix: premium 3D product render, soft matte ceramic and frosted resin materials, color palette strictly limited to cream white (#F5EEDF), Klein blue (#002FA7) and vermilion orange (#FF5A1F), clean geometric Bauhaus-inspired forms, smooth rounded edges, soft diffused studio lighting, gentle contact shadow, isolated on a plain light grey (#D6D6D6) seamless background, centered, full object visible, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark
sticker.post: python3 -I tools/cutout.py object 原图 输出（实心物件加 --fill-holes，锁 / 钥匙这类有镂空的不加）
sticker.placement: 两种场景都可以；炭黑场优先用奶油白为主的贴纸，蓝色为主的要垫卡片白卡
subjects: a closed padlock, Klein blue body with a cream white shackle and a small orange keyhole
a chunky square AI processor chip with a glowing orange core
sticker.rules: 提示词只写物件本身和三色分工；模型偶尔加灰、加金，挑图时重生。
sticker.samples: 旧陶瓷样张在 git 历史（提交 bacc451 及以前的 cards/images/samples/）；samples/ 里现在是写实样张
sticker.retired_reason: 粘土 / 陶瓷质感显得廉价、像模板（2026-11-27 用户确认，改用 real）

sc02.name: SC02 · 铅笔漫画
sc02.use: 类别 2 · 意象插画：口播没有直接说、但要让观众意会的意思（越权 = 用别人的钥匙开门；审核慢 = 趴在桌上等）。先写「要传达的意思」，再写画面

line.name: 铅笔漫画（默认）
line.use: 角色、情境、人物反应、比喻
line.prompt_suffix: manga pencil illustration on cream white paper (#F5EEDF), graphite pencil lines with fine crosshatching and soft neutral grey pencil shading, exactly one small object in the scene colored Klein blue (#002FA7) as the only colored accent, vermilion orange (#FF5A1F) only as a tiny glow of light if any (objects themselves are never orange), no other colors, no black clothing, the entire subject fully inside the frame with wide empty paper margins on all four sides, no logos or brand marks, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark
line.post: python3 -I tools/diecut.py 原图 输出.png（模切贴纸：奶油白描边 10px，默认 --tone none 保留铅笔灰；画面伸到边上的先 --crop）

duo.name: 黑白漫画（可选）
duo.use: 需要更硬朗的黑白线条时；整体冷色情绪（极少用）可加 --tone klein 映射成蓝调
duo.prompt_suffix: black-and-white manga ink illustration, bold ink lines, detailed crosshatching and screentone shading, high contrast monochrome, pure white background, the entire subject fully inside the frame with wide empty margins on all four sides, no logos or brand marks, no color at all, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark
duo.post: python3 -I tools/diecut.py 原图 输出.png（默认铅笔灰；--tone klein 为蓝调，只给冷色情绪的极少数画面）

sc02.placement: 做成模切贴纸（tools/diecut.py），炭黑场、奶油白场都能直接用；投影渲染时加（.stk.diecut / AE 图层样式「投影」）
subjects: a young security researcher with round glasses leaning toward a laptop late at night, surprised
a hand holding a key in front of a huge vault door with a small gap of light
sc02.rules: 铅笔灰打底，克莱因蓝只做一处小物件点缀（像宝石一样），不整张染蓝；提示词固定写「整个人物在画面内、四周留白」，挑图时检查有没有被裁切、有没有 logo；不得用 SC-01 的形象特征（黑帽压低遮眼、黑色工装夹克、瘦削剪影）；朱橙只做极小点缀；主体是 SC02 的镜头，类别 3 只用程序化光斑，不放写实道具。
sc02.samples: cards/images/samples/sc02/（铅笔灰模切贴纸）；色调对比 docs/previews/styles/sc02_tone_compare.jpg

toy.name: 设计师玩具角色
toy.use: 情境、讲故事、代替人物做动作（指向录屏、举牌、思考、惊讶），引导观众看信息卡
toy.prompt_suffix: stylized designer art-toy figure, premium 3D render, soft matte ceramic and smooth vinyl materials, minimal smooth face with two small dot eyes, color palette strictly limited to cream white (#F5EEDF), Klein blue (#002FA7) and vermilion orange (#FF5A1F), soft diffused studio lighting, gentle contact shadow, isolated on a plain light grey (#D6D6D6) seamless background, full body visible, no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark
toy.post: python3 -I tools/cutout.py object 原图 输出 --largest
toy.placement: 炭黑场优先；可以出血、可以压在录屏窗口边上指向标注处
subjects: a white-hat hacker wearing a cream fedora, pointing forward
a reviewer holding a magnifying glass
a developer scratching head in front of a laptop
toy.rules: 形象每期可以不同；同一期里出现多次时，用同一段角色描述保证一致。不用黑色卫衣 + 红色抽绳（和挖洞号黏土角色区分）。道具颜色也只能是三色，灰色笔记本这类要在提示词里写明颜色。
toy.retired_reason: 同为哑光陶瓷 / 搪胶玩具质感，和 sticker 一起停用（2026-11-27）

tone.name: 双色调摄影
tone.use: 情绪节点：章节卡、反转、金句、观点；作用类似挖洞号的黑白雕塑（白帽志不用雕塑）
tone.prompt_suffix: dramatic black and white fine-art photograph, single hard directional light, deep shadows, high contrast, subtle film grain, no text, no logo, no readable characters, no recognizable faces
tone.post: python3 -I tools/duotone.py 黑白.jpg 输出.jpg [--map klein]
tone.placement: 只放炭黑场：mix-blend-mode: lighten + 径向遮罩羽化融进背景（AE 里混合模式「变亮」）；主体可出血；文字压在上面时透明度 0.5–0.9
subjects: close-up of a hand on a mechanical keyboard in a dark room
a long data center corridor between server racks
a door lock with a key half inserted
a city skyline at night seen through a window
tone.rules: 禁止可辨认的真人脸、品牌、Logo、可读文字。朱橙映射用于风险 / 攻击 / 情绪；蓝色映射用于防守 / 冷静 / 对照。

iso.name: 等距微缩场景
iso.use: 讲结构、系统、流程：网站分层、请求怎么走、攻击链、权限边界
iso.prompt_suffix: isometric 3D miniature diorama, clean simplified geometric objects, soft matte ceramic materials, color palette strictly limited to cream white (#F5EEDF), Klein blue (#002FA7) and vermilion orange (#FF5A1F) with soft charcoal shadows, soft top lighting, isolated on a plain light grey (#D6D6D6) seamless background, centered, whole diorama visible, no text, no letters, no logo, no watermark
iso.post: python3 -I tools/cutout.py object 原图 输出
iso.placement: 奶油白场或炭黑场都可以；做「爆炸分层」时按层分别生成，方便逐层入场
subjects: a three-layer web application: browser on top, server in the middle, database at the bottom
a small office network with a router and three laptops
a vault room behind a series of doors
iso.rules: 首次使用先出 2 张给用户看风格（还没有样张）。
iso.retired_reason: 同为哑光陶瓷微缩质感，和 sticker 一起停用；结构、流程改用矢量图形画（2026-11-27）

device.name: 手持设备实拍
device.use: 把用户提供的截图放进手机 / 平板屏幕里：通知、APP 界面、短信、审核结果
device.prompt_suffix: realistic photograph of a hand holding a modern smartphone with a completely blank pure white screen, screen facing the camera, only the hand, wrist and phone, isolated on a plain medium grey (#8A8A8A) seamless background, soft warm key light and a warm rim light along the edges, shallow depth of field, no text, no logo, no brand marks
device.post: python3 -I tools/cutout.py object 原图 抠图.png --fill-holes → python3 -I tools/grade.py 抠图.png 调色.png → python3 -I tools/device_paste.py 调色.png 截图.png 输出.png（透明底保留；截图保留原色）
device.placement: 透明素材，只有手和手机，不带桌面和环境；炭黑场直接放
subjects: one hand holding a phone, slight tilt
phone lying on a dark desk next to a keyboard
device.rules: 屏幕必须是纯白空屏，后期贴用户截图；禁止品牌标识；不要桌面、键盘这类环境。
device.samples: cards/images/samples/device/（P5 样张 2 张 + 贴入示意截图的效果）；预览 docs/previews/styles/flat_device.jpg
device.role: 类别 1 · 手持手机（透明素材）

flat.name: 几何平面插画
flat.use: 比喻、类比：把抽象概念画成一张图（底牌亮给外人、门没锁、钥匙给错人）
flat.prompt_suffix: flat editorial vector illustration, bold simple geometric shapes, Bauhaus-inspired composition, color palette strictly limited to charcoal (#16130F), cream white (#F5EEDF), vermilion orange (#FF5A1F) and Klein blue (#002FA7), subtle paper grain, no gradients, no text, no letters, no logo
flat.placement: 放进信息卡或卡片里，不整屏铺底
subjects: an open door with a key left in the lock
a hand showing its cards to a stranger
a crowd of identical cubes with one orange cube
flat.rules: 同一个镜头里不和 3D 贴纸混用，避免两种画风打架。样张见 samples/flat/。
flat.samples: cards/images/samples/flat/（P5 样张 2 张）；预览 docs/previews/styles/flat_device.jpg
flat.retired_reason: 用途（比喻、类比）和类别 2 重叠，比喻统一交给 SC02（2026-11-27 用户确认）
